Author: EVM
Name: Elite Venue Manager
Punchline: Run your FFXIV venue: guests, bar orders, song requests, shouts.
Description: Register your venue's housing plot and see everyone who comes in (first-timers, visit counts, tonight's log). Send an automatic welcome /tell, rotate timed shouts about your games and events, take drink orders with !order and !menu, collect song requests with !song and mark them queued/played, and get a warning before your Party Finder listing expires. Open with /venue or /evm.
